notes.title: 《美女，请别影响我成仙》免费2K DLC上线公告
notes.content:
[p]《美女，请别影响我成仙》免费2K DLC上线公告

2K DLC已于7月2日14时免费上线，包体约为75G，请有需要的道友们前往下载：[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701000/2K/"][/dynamiclink]


【关于如何入库并下载此DLC】
*方法一：
在库中找到《美女，请别影响我成仙》页面，右键点击，选择 【属性】 → 【DLC】 选项卡，查看可用DLC。
*方法二：
直接在商店搜索《美女，请别影响我成仙》，进入主页，在页面下方找到 “DLC” 栏目。
购买DLC，点击DLC名称进入详情页，选择 【添加到购物车】 → 按流程完成支付（此为免费DLC，无需实际支付）；
DLC需要先拥有《美女，请别影响我成仙》本体才能购买。
购买后，DLC通常会自动下载。若未下载，右键游戏 → 【属性】 → 【DLC】，勾选对应的DLC即可。


【关于运行流畅度】
如果您在体验高清 DLC 时感觉游戏运行不够流畅或出现卡顿，可前往游戏内的“设置”界面，在画质设置中将选项从 “2K” 切换为 “高清” 模式；画质更改将在下个视频生效。


【关于误下载或不想下载2K DLC】
如您不小心将2K DLC 添加到库中，或者觉得下载体积太大、下载速度慢，您可以选择卸载此DLC，这不会影响您游玩游戏本体。
卸载方法：通过游戏属性禁用
在Steam库中右键游戏 → 【属性】 → 【DLC】。
取消勾选要卸载的DLC，Steam会移除相关文件（部分情况下重启生效）。[/p]

notes.title: "God bless，or Goddess" is now available on steam for 39.6
notes.content:
[p]Developed by steam Man Man Studio and published by Yixiangfeng Interactive Entertainment, the live-action interactive film and game "God bless，or Goddess" has officially launched on the Steam platform today, with a launch discount of only 39.6 yuan. This game is still upgraded and developed by the original team behind "God bless，or Goddess", which ranked seventh in the domestic game sales chart in 2024, sold 500,000 copies worldwide, and received numerous positive reviews on steam.[/p][p][/p][p]This time, players will take on the role of Lin Fan, the holder of the Pure Yang Spirit Root, and embark on a cultivation adventure journey interwoven with Taoist heart and love in the Crane Illusion Sect. They will experience the immersive daily life of the immortal sect from a first-person perspective, where they must both break through the realm and preserve the root.[/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/4611285b3a3a5491c80adb5669a7e0f2b29749d9.png"][/img][/p][p]The collision and interactive narrative of cultivation aesthetics offer a strong sense of sensory immersion that cannot be experienced when watching others play[/p][p]First-person perspective immersive interactive options, real-person shooting reconstructs the experience of xianxia games. The game adopts real-person live-action virtual scene fusion technology to create a wonderful cultivation world of the Crane Illusion Sect.[/p][p]Virtual-real construction: Handcrafted immortal sect building, virtually rendering the vast sea of clouds, swordplay shuttling, special effects dueling, and tribulation through celestial thunder, a brand-new cultivation game scene experience is created through the combination of virtual-real.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/cac870d8309ab23ce8f2a079b9df564e98520444.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Interactive mechanism: In the morning, watch the senior sister LAN Yunrou practice swordsmanship; at night, accompany the junior nephew to hunt demons; play wine games with the second senior sister; accompany the master to show his divine status in public; pass through tribulations with QTE. Explore more gameplay and QTE interactive mechanisms to create a unique cultivation interactive experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/e798444757d00ea0911c8cea8fe33cb395ef1e40.png"][/img] [/p][p]Sensory Enhancement: The highly sexual tension in the dialogue, the unexpected touching plot, and the meticulous emotional investment of each partner are all enhanced through a first-person perspective. Players are no longer playing a character but becoming the character itself. Whether you are playing a film game or becoming a part of it, all you need to do is join in with a light gesture.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/5f0450b68e0a6c847898193447134bc7dbefc0a2.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Multiple branching lines, 20 endings, pre-embedded Easter eggs, scene exploration, short theaters, and later discussions - all included[/p][p]The emotional branch details are fully displayed. There's no need for a master of carrying water; pure love can be pursued alone. There are also 20 endings waiting to be explored, including dual cultivation endings and multiplayer endings that fit the cultivation scene. To unlock all achievements, you need to find the embedded Easter eggs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/82802a2c8a0bcdf8c51b3cca2b08b55ffe904345.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]There is also a scene exploration system, a small theater mode, and more to discuss later. Everything is available[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/1ad2ebaf957d53b353b27f35bd5446767e6e047c.png"][/img] [/p][p]This time, "God bless，or Goddess" will present a vast array of asura fields, as well as the intricate and hilarious daily life of the sect.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594007/fdb6f6ce774bdee3470ae8f374e1cdbe62fbc907.jpg"][/img][/p][p] "God bless，or Goddess" is not only a journey to immortality, but also a soul-searching question of whether the Taoist heart can overcome hormones.[/p]

notes.title: To become immortal or not to become immortal? This is a problem
notes.content: [p][i]The cultivation world constructed in "God bless，or Goddess" is not a standard cultivation novel world, but a cultivation field full of absurdity, recklessness, and laughter; But perhaps the hardest choice is not the cultivation field, but being a human or becoming an immortal?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Eating people in front of others is called a demon. What is that person who eats people behind their backs? A great achievement leads to the withering of ten thousand bones. What about the immortal achievement? Every cannibalistic dragon was once a pure and righteous youth. Are you envious of it, understanding it, becoming it, or despising it, fighting against it, wishing the world wouldn't have it? All the hidden meanings and stories that are not spoken, I only hope that the destined person can experience them on their own. It's okay not to think about it, just laugh it off.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Finally, let's talk about the product. Don't miss some important information.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]1. The discounted price for the first release in the national region is 39.6 yuan, and the discount period for the first release is two weeks. The pricing has been confirmed during the pricing process, and the production team still adheres to the principle of repaying old friends and making new friends, expressing sincerity and allowing more people to have fun.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]2. The single line duration of the game is about 3 hours, with a total achievement time of 8-10 hours, a text volume of 150000, and 450 minutes of footage. This full achievement is still somewhat difficult, with some Easter egg content added that requires some thought. However, it doesn't matter if you don't plan to achieve it in full. I believe the ending will still satisfy everyone, without procrastination or complexity.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]3. The high-definition version is expected to be updated in the first week of July in the form of free DLC, with a capacity of approximately 80GB. Players in need are welcome to experience it at that time.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]4. The multilingual subtitle version (Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean) will be gradually updated in one month. This time, Beauty 2 will also be committed to global multi platform distribution and will place more emphasis on multilingual localization. Please be patient and wait for it, friends overseas.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]5. If you have any thoughts or suggestions during the gaming experience, please feel free to discuss them in the community! (In order not to affect others' gaming experience, some spoilers should be presented in a semi hidden way as much as possible.).[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]6. If you think the game is good after completing it to the end, please leave a recommendation for our game, which is very, very important for us. Thank you very much![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Wishing you a pleasant trip and a relaxing weekend.[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: FAQ 丨 Frequently Asked Questions and Answers for “God bless，or Goddess”
notes.content: [p][/p][p][i]God bless，or Goddess will be officially launched on June 20th at 10:00 Beijing time. Welcome to the Steam store to purchase! We have compiled the following common questions, hoping to be helpful to everyone.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Can I only play on the computer?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, currently available for purchase and download on the Steam store.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What is the selling price?[/b][/p][p]A: God bless，or Goddess  to become an immortal The official price in Chinese Mainland is 45 yuan. Two weeks before the debut, you can enjoy a discount of 88%, only 39.6 yuan![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: I purchased CDK, how do I use it[/b][/p][p]A: Please follow the steps below to activate CDK on Steam: [/p][p]1. Launch Steam and log in to your Steam account[/p][p]2. Click on the 'Game Menu'[/p][p]3. Select 'Activate product on Steam'[/p][p]4. Follow the instructions in the dialog box to complete the activation operation[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Why can't I enter the game sometimes?[/b][/p][p]A: Usually caused by network issues, you can try again after turning off VPN and restarting Steam.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Do you need an accelerator?[/b][/p][p]A: If it is in China, it is recommended to turn off the accelerator. If you are overseas, it is recommended to connect Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Germany, the United States and other nodes.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to solve the problem of frame dropping, stuttering, or only seeing UI while other videos are black?[/b][/p][p]A: You can try turning off vertical sync (right-click menu to enter Control Panel - Manage 3D Settings - Vertical Sync - Change to "Use 3D Application Settings"), and then restart Steam and apps.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: What should I do if the game frequently crashes?[/b][/p][p]A: You can try turning off compatibility mode and starting Steam (right-click Steam Properties - Compatibility - Uncheck 'Run this program in compatibility mode')[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to deal with game startup failure or other game running issues?[/b][/p][p]A: Please follow the steps below to operate in sequence[/p][p]1. Check if there are any missing local files (please right-click on the game in the Steam library - Properties - Verify Game Integrity);[/p][p]2. Check if there are any updates to the Steam platform and confirm that the Steam version number is the latest;[/p][p]3. After confirming that the configuration meets the requirements, please try performing operations such as updating graphics card drivers/clearing memory or disk space;[/p][p]4. Attempt to disable antivirus software or other security defense software on the computer;[/p][p]5. If the Steam login status is incorrect, please confirm the Steam login status. Or try entering offline mode/logging back into Steam;[/p][p]6. If the issue remains unresolved or if there are any other abnormal situations, please join the official player group for feedback[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: How to give feedback on bugs encountered in the game?[/b][/p][p]A: There are currently three official groups: Group 7536755685 (full), Group 2 823035773, and Group 3 463343548. Adding to a group or contacting the administrator can provide bug feedback. Online document feedback:  [url="https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DV3VZRUFmSkhwRVpJ?tab=BB08J2"]https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DV3VZRUFmSkhwRVpJ?tab=BB08J2[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: Is there a higher definition picture quality to choose from?[/b][/p][p]A: The high-definition version will be updated in the first week of July in the form of free DLC, with a capacity of approximately 80GB. Players in need are welcome to experience it at that time.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: I would like to recommend 'Beauty, Please Don't Hinder My Immortal' to friends abroad. Is there a multilingual version available?[/b][/p][p]A: The currently available multiple languages are coarse translation. The final version of the game has been fully confirmed; In the future, we will collaborate with overseas distribution teams to focus on optimizing multilingual versions. Currently, we have entered the "native language level" translation stage. It is expected that the multilingual version will be gradually updated in the next month.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]*We will update more tidbits for you in Tiktok and Bilibili. Search for "Beauty, Please Don't Affect Me to Become an Immortal" with the same name to follow. Welcome to post.
